title: How to (Quickly) Build a Cycling City - Paris
summary: Not Just Bikes visits Paris to see how Mayor Anne Hidalgo's policies are turning it into a '100% cyclable' city. It looks at the changes that took space from cars for bikes and people.
why: Referenced in urban planning threads on making cities less car-centric, and the channel is recommended for road and bike safety.

quote.text: Not Just Bikes on YouTube covers road/pedestrian/bike safety extensively.
